mentions.name: Forma Nest
mentions.description: A browser-based platform for building 3D room and interior designs, with no software installation or payment required; finished designs can be published and shared via public links.
mentions.problem: Typical 3D interior design tools require installing software and paying; this platform removes both barriers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was working on platform to build 3D room design for everyone who loves interior design, no need to install, no need to pay.

evidence.value: I was working on platform to build 3D room design for everyone who loves interior design, no need to install, no need to pay.
